name: Big Bass Day at the Races

features.name: Racing theme
features.description: Horse racing symbols replace the usual fishing icons.

features.name: Horse selection
features.description: Pick a horse before the bonus to reveal a feature such as extra spins or assured cash.

features.name: Scatter assist
features.description: Two scatters can trigger a random feature that adds the third.

review:
The fisherman leaves the river for the racecourse – beer, binoculars and champagne on a 5x3, 10-line grid – but the Big Bass mechanics are all still there.

Three scatters trigger the bonus (two can get a random boost for a third). Before free spins, you pick a horse that reveals a feature: more spins, assured cash prizes, removing the lowest prize value and more. Then it's the usual collect and retrigger. A fun change of scene. 96.07% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
